title: allophylus paniger
intro: Allophylus paniger, commonly known as the 'Kuruvai' or 'Kuruva', is a plant species native to India. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, and it has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Allophylus paniger include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing fever, relieving pain, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of Allophylus paniger include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
